title: [BUG] MCP client shows "token expired" for a 403 insufficient_scope response
expected: Distinguish error="invalid_token" (401) → token expired / re-authorize vs error="insufficient_scope" (403) → say the scope is missing and name it. Ideally step-up using the scope from the challenge. At minimum do not call it an expiry.
actual: Client stamps token expired over a live token. No 401. No refresh. Re-auth widened scopes (events:read events:write) rather than refreshing.
